phase_b_perhead_finding.summary: The per-head AUTO kernel (_gqa_kernel_expert) cannot take the 2-line BSND edit on ANY bench-relevant shape. Root cause (codegen-level, then empirically confirmed): under threads=2 (the serial form — taken by ALL causal shapes, odd-kv shapes and D=256, i.e. every bench per-head case r1/c5/c6), the AUTO vid-reduction pass lowers the contiguous BHSD output write correctly (per-vid blockCount=32, dst offset vid*half*D, dstStride=0) but for the strided BSND box it emits the UNSPLIT blockCount=block_M (=64) WHILE KEEPING the contiguous-layout vid offset (vid*4096): both vids then write overlapping 64-row strided windows 4 rows apart => corruption. The threads=1 pipelined form lowers correctly (single vid, blockCount=64, dstStride=1792B, BITOK) but no bench per-head case lands there: use_pipeline requires non-causal AND D<=128 AND even kv>=2, and such eligible shapes with >=20 instances route to the expert kernels instead — per-head only receives causal / odd-kv / D!=128 / tiny-instance shapes, i.e. threads=2 (or non-bench tiny shapes).
evidence: codegen_audit_iter9.log + codegen_iter9_perhead_{r1,c5,pipe}_{base,w2}.cu: base Output write copy_ub_to_gm<half,128,32>(..., 128, 32, 128) [blockCount=32, dstStride=0] vs w2 (..., 1024, 64, 128) [blockCount=64, dstStride=1792B] with the dst offset retaining vid*4096 — numeric decode: vid0 writes s=[bx*64, bx*64+64), vid1 writes s=[bx*64+4, bx*64+68) at the same head => overlap + cross-block spill

framework_findings: AUTO-mode (TL_ASCEND_AUTO_CV_COMBINE + AUTO_SYNC) vid-reduction correctly splits a CONTIGUOUS UB->GM box write across threads=2 (each vid: blockCount=half, dst offset vid*half*D, dstStride=0) but MIS-LOWERS a STRIDED BSND box write: it emits the UNSPLIT blockCount=block_M while KEEPING the contiguous-layout vid offset (vid*half*D instead of vid*half*N_q*D). Both vids then write overlapping block_M-row strided windows offset by (half*D)/(N_q*D) rows => corruption (measured: r1 maxabsdiff 5.9e4, c5 NaN). The threads=1 pipelined form is correct (single vid, no split). RULE: strided/BSND GM output writes are safe ONLY in expert-mode manual-flag kernels (where the vid split is explicit in the source and the lowering keeps blockCount=half with a recomputed BSND vid offset) or in AUTO threads=1 forms — NOT in AUTO threads=2 (which every causal / odd-kv / D!=128 per-head shape takes). Evidence: codegen_audit_iter9.log + codegen_iter9_perhead_{r1,c5,pipe}_{base,w2}.cu + bit_probe_iter9.log.

The wave-1 (iter8) BSND mechanism transfers VERBATIM to the two expert-mode prefill kernels (prefill_expert per-head-tasks, g2stack ns-batched) — same 2-line edit (Output decl + FIN box), same single copy_ub_to_gm/DataCopyPad per box with blockCount=half preserved and only dstStride changed, same bit-identity, same 'main can get faster' L2 effect (c8 main -0.35%). The manual vid protocol (vid*half already in the source row index) is what makes the strided lowering correct here vs the AUTO threads=2 defect above.

Causal variable-length kv (per-task kv_useful) does NOT interact with the BSND output write: the FIN box is emitted once per task AFTER the kv loop, independent of kv_useful. Bit-identity held on causal kv=2/4/8 g2stack and causal kv=1/4 prefill_expert (Gate 0). The strided-write edit surface is orthogonal to the causal-skip mechanism.

The Phase-A cost model calibrated in wave-1 (probe ns/box x box-count for the strided increment; benefit = the full eliminated tout TaskDur; main often nets faster from the removed L2 write+read pass) predicts wave-2 e2e within +/-1.0pp on all four covered shapes (c19 +0.05pp, c8 +0.68pp, c9 -0.30pp, c10 +0.97pp) WITHOUT re-running the rate probe — the wave-1 calibration transfers across kernels and shapes. A wave-2-specific rate probe was therefore unnecessary (skipped, budget).

bench-wall vs B-matrix-kernel-sum口径 gap is shape-size dependent and concentrated in the main kernel of SMALL shapes: c19 bench 42.94us vs B-matrix 57.40us, c5 65.74 vs 77.10 (the msprof --launch-count=3 main is colder than the bench steady-state warm-L2 loop), while LARGE shapes nearly coincide (c8 858 vs 860.68, c9 659 vs 650.60).
